constraints: Cite a source for every financial figure you record.

tool_arguments.query: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue custom accelerators XPUs Q2 fiscal 2026 quarterly earnings

events.content: Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue custom accelerators XPUs Q2 fiscal 2026 quarterly earnings

Broadcom reported **$16.7 billion of AI-semiconductor revenue in fiscal Q3 2026**, ended **August 2, 2026**, up **221% year over year** and **54% sequentially**. [[1]] 

Management attributed the acceleration to very strong demand for **custom AI accelerators (XPUs)** and AI networking; total company revenue was **$29.6 billion**, so AI semiconductors represented roughly **56%** of quarterly revenue. [[1]] [[2]] 

The XPU product cycle included high-volume delivery of Google’s **Ironwood TPU v7** to Google and Anthropic, while Broadcom also identified custom XPU programs for OpenAI (“Jalapeño”) and Meta (MTIA). [[3]] 

For fiscal Q4 2026, Broadcom guided AI-semiconductor revenue to **$21.7 billion**, or **236% year-over-year growth**, implying continued sharp expansion in custom accelerators and networking. [[1]]

Sources:
[S1.1] Broadcom Inc. Announces Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results and Quarterly Dividend — https://investors.broadcom.com/news-releases/news-release-details/broadcom-inc-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial
